settings.title: Settings
onboarding.welcome.title: Hi, I'm Lumi!
onboarding.welcome.body: Isla Desk is a tiny island at the top of your screen. It shows your music, code review results, and health reminders. All data stays on your laptop.
onboarding.ai.title: Choose an AI brain
onboarding.ai.body: Used to check your code before git push. You can change it anytime in Settings.
onboarding.permissions.title: System permissions
onboarding.permissions.body: Isla Desk doesn't ask for any special system permission right now. If it ever needs one, we'll tell you here.
onboarding.autostart.title: Start automatically
onboarding.autostart.body: The island is ready every time you log in.
